summary.headline: Judging Perfection of a Matter
summary.text: Astrological rules for judging whether a matter is perfected, based on conjunctions and aspects involving the lord of the ascendant, Moon, lord of the midheaven, benefic and malefic planets, reception, disposition, angles, dignity, and exaltation. The instructions continue with conjunctions to planets and stars in the ascendant and midheaven.
